This indicates a potential pathway where Clindamycin may contribute to Pneumonitis through its role in treating a related condition. The evidence is consistent across two paths, with slight variations in the intermediate drugs (Mezlocillin vs. Azlocillin), suggesting that the relationship may be context-dependent or involve different mechanisms of action.
